neptune.conjunction: You belong to a generation that pulled its ideals loose from their institutions, and you have never quite trusted a settled belief.
neptune.harmonious: You can imagine an entirely different arrangement of things without being frightened by it, and you are patient about getting there.
neptune.square: Your ideals and your need for freedom undercut each other, and you have abandoned causes as readily as you took them up.
neptune.opposition: The vision and the disruption arrive separately, and you have watched a good many people mistake one of them for the other.

pluto.conjunction: You came in with a generation that broke things open, and your personal upheavals have always had a wider tide behind them.
pluto.harmonious: You can handle radical change without needing to be the one controlling it, which is rarer than it sounds.
pluto.square: You force change and then resent the instability, and the crises of your life have been self-detonated as often as not.
pluto.opposition: You have lived through the collision of what was and what had to be, and you were not the one who chose the timing.

ascendant.conjunction: People find you striking and slightly unplaceable, and you would far rather be interesting than approved of.
ascendant.harmonious: Your unconventionality is easy to be around: people notice it straight away and are not put off by it.
ascendant.square: You are read as contrary before you have done anything, and the reaction confirms the position you had already taken.
ascendant.opposition: The unpredictable ones are always the people you end up with, and your life changes direction through them.

midheaven.conjunction: Your career has taken turns nobody could have planned, and you are known for doing it your own way.
midheaven.harmonious: You can make a living out of what makes you unusual, and the sideways move has generally worked out.
midheaven.square: You cannot stay inside a structure once it settles, and you have left positions for the freedom rather than for anything better.
midheaven.opposition: Your work keeps disrupting your home or the other way about, and none of the upheavals were scheduled by you.
